title: Compute an Entropy-Regularized State Value
summary: A stochastic robot policy values both task reward and action entropy.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Reward and value share fixed reward units; log densities and entropy are in natural-log units; normalized action coordinates are dimensionless.

physical_contract.axes: Explicit batch/sample/channel axes defined in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: One aligned transition per record; true termination differs from time-limit truncation. No physical simulator runs.
physical_contract.batching: Explicit batch/sample/channel axes defined in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Original bounded component using supplied policy/value data. No online learning, external model weights or full-paper benchmark reproduction.
